master_host.description: Hostname or IP address the master server listens on for client connections.

master_port.description: TCP port the master server listens on for client connections.

data_path.description: Directory where metadata (chunks metadata, changelog, session files) is stored.

exports_file.description: Path to the file defining exported directories and access permissions.

meta_logging.description: Whether to log metadata changes (e.g., file operations) to a changelog file for recovery.

max_open_files.description: Maximum number of open file descriptors (0 means use the system's limit).

worker_processes.description: Number of worker threads for handling client requests (0 = automatically set to number of CPU cores).

heartbeat_timeout.description: Time in seconds after which a chunkserver is considered dead if no heartbeat is received.

heartbeat_interval.description: Interval in seconds between chunkserver heartbeat messages.

access_logging.description: Whether to log all file access operations (read/write/open/close).

metadata_replicas.description: List of metadata replica servers (for high availability). Each entry includes host, port, and optional weight.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the metadata replica.

port.description: Port number of the metadata replica (typically 9421).

weight.description: Load weight for this replica (used in round-robin).

garbage_collection.description: Enable or disable garbage collection of deleted chunks (recommended for production).

trash_expire_time.description: Time in seconds before deleted chunks in the trash are permanently removed.

balancing.description: Enable automatic balancing of chunk distribution across chunkervers.

min_free_space_mb.description: Minimum free space (in MB) required on a chunkserver before it rejects new writes.

max_chunk_size_mb.description: Maximum size (in MB) of a single data chunk. Larger chunks improve performance for big files.

stats_http_enabled.description: Enable the built-in HTTP stats server for monitoring cluster status.

stats_http_host.description: Interface (IP or hostname) the HTTP stats server binds to.

stats_http_port.description: Port for the HTTP stats server.

stats_http_password_file.description: Optional path to a file containing username:password for HTTP stats access.

secure_mode.description: Enable secure mode — requires password for all administrative operations (e.g., via mfsmount -o password).

read_only_mode.description: Enable read-only mode — no writes allowed (useful during maintenance or recovery).
